name: Libingan
description: A resting place for the barangay's dead, kept in the way of its tradition. The barangay mourns its losses faster with one, and it keeps the names of the remembered.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Robert B. Fox, The Tabon Caves (National Museum of the Philippines, 1970)
